news.title: Atlanta police recruit dies in crash on Moreland Avenue
news.summary: An Atlanta police recruit on his way to training died Tuesday morning following a motorcycle crash on Moreland Avenue.

news.title: Cartersville man accused of swimming across lake to flee AL deputies
news.summary: Authorities say a Cartersville man jumped into Weiss Lake in Alabama while trying to avoid arrest.

news.title: Woman reports romance scam. Police told her she may have committed a crime
news.summary: A metro Atlanta woman says she is the victim of a romance scam. But when she went to report it to police, she was told she also might have committed a crime.

news.title: Family dispute leads to shooting on Griffin Street in NW Atlanta
news.summary: One person was taken to the hospital after an overnight shooting at a home in northwest Atlanta.

news.title: Marietta police registry aims to find missing vulnerable adults
news.summary: Marietta police launched a voluntary registry to speed up searches for missing vulnerable individuals who have trouble communicating.

news.title: Missing veteran has not contacted family since July jail release
news.summary: Rockdale County deputies need help locating missing 43-year-old Marlena Perrin.

news.title: Father granted bond after getting new trial in 2003 death of 2-month-old baby
news.summary: Danyel Smith was granted a new trial in July by a Gwinnett County judge.

news.title: Man arrested after trying to rob Atlanta Wells Fargo bank with note
news.summary: It was determined that the suspect passed a note to a bank employee demanding $25,000.

news.title: Mother charged after allegedly giving teen daughters golf club used to hit other teens during fight
news.summary: Newnan Police said Tuesday that 36-year-old Curtisia Heath is facing an aggravated assault charge.
